statement: The function returns a result out (Result.ok out) and there is a node v of root such that: (1) every deepest node of root is v or a descendant of v; (2) no immediate child of v has the property that every deepest node of root is that child or a descendant of that child; and (3) out is exactly the subtree of root rooted at v, i.e. the tree consisting of v and all descendants of v, with the same left and right child relationships as in root. The depth of a node is its distance from the root (the root has depth 0), and a deepest node of root is a node whose depth equals the maximum depth over all nodes of root.
preconditions: root ≠ Tree.Null; root has at most 500 nodes; every node value is an integer in [0,500]; and all node values in root are pairwise distinct.

statement: The function returns a result out (Result.ok out); in particular, it does not fail, panic, access out of bounds, or overflow.
preconditions: root ≠ Tree.Null; root has at most 500 nodes; every node value is an integer in [0,500]; and all node values in root are pairwise distinct.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result out, out ≠ Tree.Null.
preconditions: root ≠ Tree.Null; root has at most 500 nodes; every node value is an integer in [0,500]; and all node values in root are pairwise distinct.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result out, out is a subtree of root: there exists a node v of root such that out is obtained from root by keeping exactly v and all descendants of v, with their original left and right child relationships, and deleting every other node.
preconditions: root ≠ Tree.Null; root has at most 500 nodes; every node value is an integer in [0,500]; and all node values in root are pairwise distinct.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result out, every deepest node of root occurs as a node of out, using the inclusion of out as a subtree of root.
preconditions: root ≠ Tree.Null; root has at most 500 nodes; every node value is an integer in [0,500]; and all node values in root are pairwise distinct.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result out and v is the root node of out, for every node w of root such that every deepest node of root is w or a descendant of w, the node v is a descendant-or-equal of w. Equivalently, for every node w of root whose subtree contains all deepest nodes of root, the subtree out is contained in the subtree of root rooted at w.
preconditions: root ≠ Tree.Null; root has at most 500 nodes; every node value is an integer in [0,500]; and all node values in root are pairwise distinct.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result out (Result.ok out) and v is the root node of out (so out is the subtree of root rooted at v), v is the lowest common ancestor of all deepest nodes of root: (i) every deepest node of root is v or a descendant of v; and (ii) for every node w of root that is an ancestor-or-equal of every deepest node, w is an ancestor-or-equal of v (equivalently, v is w or a descendant of v).
preconditions: root ≠ Tree.Null; root has at most 500 nodes; every node value is an integer in [0,500]; and all node values in root are pairwise distinct.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result out, if out is viewed as the subtree of root rooted at its root node v, then the set of nodes of out whose depth measured from v is maximum within out is exactly the set of deepest nodes of root, viewed as nodes of root and hence of out.
preconditions: root ≠ Tree.Null; root has at most 500 nodes; every node value is an integer in [0,500]; and all node values in root are pairwise distinct.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result out, out = Tree.Node(value(d), Tree.Null, Tree.Null), i.e. the one-node tree whose only value is the value of d.
preconditions: root ≠ Tree.Null; root has at most 500 nodes; every node value is an integer in [0,500]; all node values in root are pairwise distinct; and root has exactly one node d at maximum depth.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result out, out = root.
preconditions: root = Tree.Node(x, left, right) with left ≠ Tree.Null and right ≠ Tree.Null; root has at most 500 nodes; every node value is an integer in [0,500]; all node values in root are pairwise distinct; and height(left) = height(right), where height(Tree.Null) = -1 and height(Tree.Node(_, a, b)) = 1 + max(height(a), height(b)).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result out, out is exactly the subtree of left rooted at the lowest common ancestor, within left, of all deepest nodes of left.
preconditions: root = Tree.Node(x, left, right) with left ≠ Tree.Null; root has at most 500 nodes; every node value is an integer in [0,500]; all node values in root are pairwise distinct; and height(left) > height(right), where height(Tree.Null) = -1 and height(Tree.Node(_, a, b)) = 1 + max(height(a), height(b)).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result out, out is exactly the subtree of right rooted at the lowest common ancestor, within right, of all deepest nodes of right.
preconditions: root = Tree.Node(x, left, right) with right ≠ Tree.Null; root has at most 500 nodes; every node value is an integer in [0,500]; all node values in root are pairwise distinct; and height(right) > height(left), where height(Tree.Null) = -1 and height(Tree.Node(_, a, b)) = 1 + max(height(a), height(b)).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result out, every integer value occurring in out is an integer in [0,500] and occurs in root.
preconditions: root ≠ Tree.Null; root has at most 500 nodes; every node value is an integer in [0,500]; and all node values in root are pairwise distinct.
